title: Sticky residue
text: Sticky residue. These were pretty straightforward to assemble like anything else you might find at IKEA or a similar store. Ours are all white and they are an OK value for the money so we were concerned with the stickers like most other reviewers. We tried a lot of different products including Goo Gone but it still did not get everything off of it which is disappointing because it really does detract from the chairs themselves. Because the sticker residue hung around they got dirty very easily and because we got the white chairs it’s very very obvious that they are all sticky. I had gotten these for the waiting room at my clinical practice but unfortunately with the way they look they are not usable for that application so I’ll be taking these home to see if I can get the rest of the sticky stuff off and maybe my two-year-old can use them.
